name: Herringbone Fold
description: The first clip collapses along a herringbone of zigzag creases like a folded map: in one motion it pleats in both directions at once, its facets lit and shaded in alternation, into a small compact packet that drops out of the frame, revealing the second clip under its shadow. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: rows
params.description: Number of pleat rows across the height of the frame

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the shadow cast by the folding sheet
